protocol.development: Original 96 train and 32 validation backgrounds. Previous tests are context only. Reused validation, exploratory selection.

fresh.gate: All policies and dependency hashes frozen before generation.

protocol.selection: Sequential: box-only grid on original score; score/scale/reference grid holding selected boxes fixed; independent multiscale and template grids. Shared winner and count-specific winners by F1, fewer FP, deterministic order.

references.periodic: five harmonics, three Tukey IRLS updates, stride16 fit

scores.calibration: per-image row MAD; additionally long-reference count-specific clean-training MAD

protocol.multiscale: sigma^2 times Laplacian of Gaussian at 1,2,4,8 on signed median residual; extrema over scale and 3x3 space; row MAD significance; diameter 2sqrt(2)sigma times validation-selected factor; periodic NMS
protocol.templates: Signed paired quiet pore-minus-clean training patches, averaged within size x radial-position x pore-family bins; unit-energy filters; mask-derived prototype box dimensions. Full-image correlation, no test truth or radial snapping.
protocol.limitations: Synthetic, known ring coordinates, one pore per defective image. Templates use labelled simulator-derived training priors. No physical model changes.

development_amendment.reason: Original-score box optimum uses area8/no merge; reassess interactions after reference/calibration changes.
development_amendment.search: Best initial score operating point within each of five reference/calibration branches; also short/near adaptive floor.003 threshold16. Re-evaluate all 72 box settings per distinct operating point.
development_amendment.confirmation_state: Not frozen; no fresh confirmation images exist

locked_controls.purpose: Single-setting controls, not additional selection candidates

audit.limits: No full regeneration replay or physical validation. Timing is a three-scene descriptive check, includes verification and is not a hardware benchmark.
